job.title: Trainee Admin Coordinator
job.description:
About MobReady: 
MobReady is a socially inclusive Group Training Organisation (GTO) offering traineeship and apprenticeship opportunities for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people. A recognised Supply Nation Certified business, our vision is to stimulate positive change by providing trainee and apprentice employment opportunities, supporting a diverse and inclusive workplace culture toward achieving sustainable outcomes.
 
The Role: 
MobReady are actively seeking First Nations Trainee Administration Coordinator
to join one of Australia's leading experts in cutting‑edge transport technology. Based in Bowen Hills, QLD.
 
This is a fantastic entry‑level opportunity for someone eager to build a career in both administration and warehouse operations.
 
This role is targeted for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander candidates only. 
 
The successful candidate will receive Culturally sensitive mentoring to ensure they have all the support necessary to succeed. 
 
Ideal Candidate Traits:
  • Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander
  • Pass a Police check
  • Ability to pass drug and alcohol testing
  • Strong communication and organisational skills
  • Willingness to learn, take direction, and grow within the business
  • A positive attitude and commitment to safety
What We Offer
  • Full training and ongoing support
  • Exposure to both office and warehouse operations
  • A stable, long‑standing company with a proud history of innovation
  • Career development opportunities in a growing industry
This is a targeted position under the anti-Discrimination Act 1977 persons of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent are encouraged to apply and preference for the role. If this sounds like you, APPLY NOW! Please reach out to us for a yarn.

job.title: Trainee Administration Officer
job.description:
About MobReady: 
MobReady is a socially inclusive Group Training Organisation (GTO) offering traineeship and apprenticeship opportunities for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people. A recognised Supply Nation Certified business, our vision is to stimulate positive change by providing trainee and apprentice employment opportunities, supporting a diverse and inclusive workplace culture toward achieving sustainable outcomes.
 
Trainee Administration Officer
Location: Narrabri, NSW
Employment Type: Full-Time Traineeship (12 Months)
Course - Certificate III Business Administration
 
Are you looking to kick-start your career in administration and business operations?

MobReady is seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Trainee Administration Officer to join our host employer's team and gain hands-on experience across multiple areas of their organisation.
 
This is an exciting opportunity to develop practical workplace skills, complete a recognised qualification, and gain exposure to a variety of business functions while working alongside experienced professionals.

About the Role
As a Trainee Administration Officer, you will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day operations of the business while learning about the broader business.

You will have the opportunity to work across several departments, gaining valuable experience in:
  • Finance
    • Processing invoices
    • Assisting with financial administration and record keeping
    • Supporting reporting and reconciliation activities
  • Business Administration & Operations
    • Reception and customer service support
    • Vender Management
    • Document and records management
    • Meeting coordination and event support
    • General office administration
  • Contracting
    • Assisting with contract administration processes
    • Supporting project and contractor documentation
    • Maintaining records and databases
    • Learning about procurement and governance requirements
This unique rotational experience will provide a comprehensive understanding of how different teams work together to support the business' objectives.
 
About You
We are looking for someone who is:
  • Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander
  • Committed to completing relevant trainee studies and workplace learning
  • Eager to learn and develop new skills
  • Organised and detail-oriented
  • Reliable and professional
  • A strong communicator with good interpersonal skills
  • Comfortable using Microsoft Office applications or willing to learn
  • Able to work both independently and as part of a team
What We Offer
  • A supportive and inclusive team environment
  • Exposure to multiple business functions and career pathways
  • On-the-job training and mentoring
  • Opportunities to develop professional and administrative skills
  • A nationally recognised qualification through a traineeship program
  • A chance to contribute to an organisation that supports Australia's cotton industry
About CRDC
The Cotton Research and Development Corporation (CRDC) is responsible for investing in research, development and extension activities that improve the productivity, profitability and sustainability of the Australian cotton industry.
We work closely with growers, researchers, industry partners and government stakeholders to deliver outcomes that benefit the industry and regional communities.
 
How to Apply
To apply, please submit:
  • A current resume; and
  • A brief cover letter outlining your interest in the role and why you would like to join CRDC.
The successful candidate will receive Culturally sensitive mentoring to ensure they have all the support necessary to succeed. 
 
This is a targeted position under the anti-Discrimination Act 1977 persons of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent are encouraged to apply and preference for the role. If this sounds like you, APPLY NOW! Please reach out to us for a yarn.
